I'm sorry the replacement didn't make it either. Yes, you're eligible. A replacement plant has its own new 30-day guarantee, and at 20 days you're still within it, so you can claim one more free replacement (store credit if the plant is out of stock).

To claim, go to "My Orders" and submit at least two photos (the whole plant and a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back. The claim is covered if the plant died or declined significantly despite reasonable care, but not if it was due to pests introduced after delivery or deliberate neglect.

This second replacement won't come with a guarantee of its own. If you'd like care advice to help it thrive, a Plant Care Specialist can help by chat or email.
